versions.content: Specification of Diagnostic over IP AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 49 of 129 Document ID 418 : AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticOverIP - AUTOSAR confidential - If PduR_DoIP Tp CopyRxData returns BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK, the DoIP module shall react as described in SWS_DoIP_00174, discard all the TCP data until the next DoIP message and call the PduR_DoI P Tp RxIndication with the according PduId and the result set to E_NOT_OK.

If PduR_DoIPTpCopyRxData returns BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK, the DoIP module shall react as described in SWS_DoIP_00174, discard all the TCP data until the next DoIP message and call the PduR_DoIPTpRxIndication with the ac- cording PduId and the result set to E_NOT_OK.

If PduR_DoIPTpCopyRxData returns BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK, the DoIP module shall discard all the TCP data until the next DoIP message and call the PduR_DoIPTpRxIndication with the according PduId and the result set to E_NOT_ OK.

If PduR_DoIPTpCopyRxData returns BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK, the DoIP module shall discard all the TCP data until the next DoIP message and call the PduR_DoIPTpRxIndication with the according PduId and the result set to E_NOT_ OK.
